Women higher odds Affective interest relative Fidelity, much lower odds Infidelity relative Fidelity — line paper’s finding “men likely belong sexual desire class women emotional interest fidelity classes.” Age. Older respondents higher odds Infidelity relative Fidelity, matching paper’s finding age significantly related class membership. Sexual orientation. One row looks like discovery paper’s classify--analyze approach missed: non-heterosexual respondents higher odds Sexual desire relative Fidelity (= 2.75, p = .022). omnibus test sexual orientation — one built ask whether covariate distinguishes pair classes — significant either (Wald chi-square = 6.44, df = 3, p = .092), matching paper’s null result. three pairwise contrasts tested, single row .05 strong evidence ; read omnibus row first, treat isolated significant contrast beside non-significant omnibus test hypothesis worth better-powered look, confirmed finding. Neither approach finds significant association, consistent paper. good illustration mixtureEM applies bias correction whenever classes related external variables: “obvious” approach classifying testing valid classification (almost) perfect, rarely true practice.

title: Repeated-Measures Latent Class Analysis — fit_rmlca
text: Fits repeated-measures latent class model data indicators observed several occasions. person belongs one latent class whole study, classes describe trajectories: patterns response span occasions rather snapshot one . Collins Lanza's RMLCA (2010, sec. 7.2); continuous indicators model Wang Wang's longitudinal latent profile analysis (2020, sec. 6.3.1), obtained simply setting measurement = "continuous". likelihood ordinary latent class model applied \(J \times T\) stacked indicators, $$P(y_i) = \sum_k \gamma_k \prod_t \prod_j \rho_{jtk}(y_{ijt}),$$ everything package already offers — model selection, bootstrap likelihood-ratio test, predictors class membership, distal outcomes, survey designs FIML missing data — applies unchanged. measurement_invariance controls whether item-response parameters \(\rho_{jtk}\) held equal across occasions. Constraining makes class label mean thing every occasion sharply reduces number free parameters; leaving free lets item behave differently time. two models nested, lr_test() tests restriction directly.
